description: This file defines an admin controller class for managing icon-related actions within the Goteo project. It includes methods for listing, editing, translating, and processing icon data, with access control based on user roles and project configuration.

classes.name: IconsSubController
classes.description: A controller class for managing icon entities in the admin interface, providing actions to list, edit, translate, and process icons with role-based access control.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has the necessary permissions to access the controller's actions based on node configuration and user roles.

methods.name: translateAction
methods.description: Handles the translation-related action for icons by delegating to the generalized process method.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles the editing action for icons, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles listing of icons, delegating to the process method.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to handle listing, editing, and saving icon data based on POST data and action type, including permission checks, saving logic, and user feedback.
